articles.title: Fossils from 1.7 Billion Years Ago Could Rewrite the Story of Complex Life's Origins
articles.summary: Newly discovered microfossils from Canada may be the oldest complex cells ever found, pushing back the timeline for eukaryotes. The 1.7-billion-year-old specimens show possible signs of cell engulfment, a key step in evolution.

articles.title: Ahsoka Season 2 Trailer Reveals Release Date, Massive Battles, and More Anakin
articles.summary: The first trailer for Ahsoka season 2 debuted at D23, revealing a January 20, 2027 premiere on Disney Plus. It teases epic space battles, Thrawn's threat, and a larger role for Anakin Skywalker.

articles.title: When a Child's Robot Friend Dies: The Rise and Fall of AI Companion Toys
articles.summary: Moxie, a social robot for neurodivergent kids, became a lifeline for some children. But when its maker shut down, the robots stopped working, exposing the risks of AI companions that depend on corporate servers.
